title: Marketer profile and verified reviews
guidance: New human feedback covers review/filter composition, bounded long-comment disclosure, removal of the verification explainer and rating-bar color. This supersedes the earlier shared-pattern-only review status.
Latest human direction: rebalance filter/title, minimal pagination, inspect necessity/access of Job links, retain long-comment disclosure.

Latest human correction: make compact arrow paging hover more noticeable. Use a soft tonal circular fill plus a fine inset edge on enabled Previous/Next. This icon-navigation exception does not change quiet text-button hover.

decisions.title: Named manual feedback is implemented
decisions.reason: The review list/filter, long-comment disclosure, neutral rating series and removal of the verification explainer are recorded in their searchable component entries. A01/A04/B02 have human feedback; full-page acceptance and all other human-unvisited states remain pending.

decisions.title: Discoverable compact pagination hover
decisions.reason: Shared compact+quiet recipe covers My Jobs and Reviews. Rest is transparent/borderless, targets do not shift, focus remains explicit, touch does not retain hover and reduced motion keeps static feedback.

parameters.name: Story ownership

parameters.name: Compact icon hover
